subject.title: chore(scripts): remove resolved investigation tools and orphans

question: Should the project accept removal of the internal Code Mode plugin-namespace registration seam after confirming that no supported or planned plugin contract relies on it?
rationale: The code change appears bounded, but this PR removes an internal integration boundary and carries the protected `maintainer` label; automated review cannot establish the intended long-term Code Mode extension contract.

options.title: Confirm removal and request runtime proof
options.body: Confirm that plugin namespace registration was never a supported contract, then require a redacted real Code Mode/MCP namespace run before merge.

options.title: Preserve a supported extension seam
options.body: Keep or replace the registration API only if maintainers intend external or loader-owned namespace integrations beyond MCP catalog entries.

recommendation.title: Confirm removal and request runtime proof
recommendation.body: Confirm that plugin namespace registration was never a supported contract, then require a redacted real Code Mode/MCP namespace run before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the removal and documented the repaired ownership decision; they are the best available routing candidate in the supplied history.
